description: Defines the LoadBalancerEncoder class and related interfaces for encoding QUIC load balancer connection IDs, including configuration management and routing logic.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoder
classes.description: Manages QUIC load balancer configurations and encodes connection IDs accordingly.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about configuration changes.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new LoadBalancerEncoder instance with no active config.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Replaces current config and server ID if valid.

methods.name: DeleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes current config and switches to unroutable IDs.

methods.name: GenerateConnectionId
methods.description: Generates a connection ID based on current config or unroutable ID.
